channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: After meeting in the military, Janaya and Benoit instantly connected. Janaya has always dreamed of returning to Nova Scotia, and Benoit is ready to help make that dream a reality; now they are on the hunt for a seaside home that keeps them close to family, offers a private retreat for just the two of them, and gives them the perfect place to build their life together.
